name: jit-orchestration-governor
description: Bounded JIT guard for immediate orchestration actions

interface.shortDescription: Guard JIT orchestration metadata before material actions.
interface.longDescription: Evaluates complete PreToolUse orchestration metadata, denies only an improper Seat 0 worker action or a missing-authority action, and records bounded private diagnostics without blocking the project.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check this material action against JIT orchestration requirements.
